conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Achieving transparency often involves explainable AI (XAI) techniques, which help us understand how models make decisions. Another approach is to design models with inherent interpretability from the start, rather than trying to explain them afterward.

conversation.message: That makes a lot of sense. Are there any specific XAI techniques that seem most promising?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Some promising techniques include LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations) and SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), as well as attention mechanisms in deep learning. These methods offer different ways to peek inside the "black box" of complex models.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
